body:
blocked: this issue waits for `#1962`, `#1965`, and `#1968` on `upstream/main`.

I checked `upstream/main` at commit `31f8d03d` and all open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- `#1962` (open, no PR): `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs`, `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs`, and `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` do not define, parse, or validate `pivot`, `offset`, `zero_offset`, `rollover`, or `controller.rtcp`.
- `#1962` (open, no PR): `crates/post/src/post/machine.rs` still infers `rtcp` from rotary tilt and does not read `controller.rtcp`.
- `#1965` (open, draft PR `#2056`): `upstream/main` has no AC inverse kinematics solver (`camcraft_post::kinematics`). PR `#2056` keeps `.mch` schema wiring, `mach4.cps`, and `machine::check_ops` out of scope.
- `#1968` (open, no PR): `assets/posts/mach4.cps` does not exist, and `BUILTINS` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` registers no Mach4 post.

Without these three prerequisites:

- `crates/app/src/machine/fields.rs` and `crates/app/src/machine/sheet.rs` cannot bind to validator keys or parsed trunnion fields from `#1962`.
- A setup datum-to-pivot offset has no inverse kinematics solver (`#1965`) and no non-RTCP multi-axis job path to refuse.
- A Mach4 XYZAC sample `.mch` cannot store trunnion fields or mirror `controller.rtcp` as `false`.

Note for work after `#1962`, `#1965`, and `#1968` merge:

- Open PR `#1753` (`merge-ready`, issue `#1135`) also edits `MACHINES` in `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration` in `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`.

I stopped before claiming `#1970`. I made no branch, no worktree, no code change, and no PR.
